frontmatter.title: Pricing AI Applications: Per Request vs Per Successful Outcome

frontmatter.excerpt: Explore the two dominant pricing models for AI applications-per request and per successful outcome-and learn when each model makes sense, where it fails, and how to choose the right one for real-world AI products.
